population.note: Sold-out game at Oriole Park at Camden Yards (2026 seating capacity 42,455; venue record 49,828). Every person present is treated as a casualty.

triage_counts_note: 1+7+25+68 = 101%, which gives 45,450. BLACK, RED and YELLOW keep the stated counts; GREEN is reduced from 30,600 to 30,150 so the total is 45,000.
free_bed_share_note: Maryland sets licensed acute beds at 140% of average daily census, so about 1 - 1/1.4 = 29% of licensed beds are free on an average day. Upper bound: staffed beds are fewer than licensed beds.

on_request: Baltimore City Health Department (Off-Site Triage, Treatment, and Transport Centers, OST3C)

assumptions.unit_assignment: The 16 medic units and 8 suppression companies come from the stations nearest the MCI pickup point (straight-line distance), S001 first.
assumptions.deterioration: No published per-patient rate exists. Each scenario keeps its own existing per-triage timing and deterioration pattern (scenario_profiles.json), repeated over the new patients.
